title: Home-Site Lease Collections Standard: Repayment Plan Length by Size of the Covered Balance
content:
**Collections standard — length of a Home-Site Lease repayment plan**

The covered balance is the amount demanded by the most recent nonpayment notice on the lease. How the plan length, in plan months, is set depends on the covered balance compared with the monthly site rent on the lease:

| Covered balance | Plan months |
|---|---|
| no more than 0.6 times (60 percent of) the monthly site rent | one for each 200.00 of the covered balance or part thereof |
| above 1.2 times the monthly site rent | one for each 0.5 times (half) the monthly site rent in the covered balance, or part thereof |
| any other covered balance | the lot class's most installments, as plan months |

"Or part thereof" means that a remainder short of a full 200.00, or of a full half-month of rent, still counts as one plan month.

**Worked figures (hypothetical monthly site rent of 700.00: 0.6 times is 420.00, 1.2 times is 840.00, half the rent is 350.00)**

| Covered balance | Band | Plan months |
|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | no more than 420.00 | 1 |
| 400.00 | no more than 420.00 | 2 |
| 420.00 | no more than 420.00 (on the boundary) | 3 (two full 200.00 and a part) |
| 840.00 | neither (not above 840.00) | the lot class's most installments |
| 840.01 | above 840.00 | 3 (two full 350.00 and a part) |
| 1,400.00 | above 840.00 | 4 (exactly four times 350.00) |
| 1,482.50 | above 840.00 | 5 (four full 350.00 and a part) |
